description: Land Acquisition - Punchi Lewakanda, Yatawatta D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a declaration by the Minister of Lands that a specific parcel of land ("Mahalewakanda Estate") is being acquired for a public purpose, including detailed descriptions of the land's location, boundaries, and extent. This fits the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters.
